title: Vinehop at Phaedrus Estate
summary: Phaedrus Estate is a host venue for the 2026 Vinehop festival, with live music and a DJ from Fudge and Jinxit from 11.30am to 5pm and three food trucks. Festival tickets are sold through Vinehop.
